text: SOLUTION We leave the computation of the limits used in the limit comparison test (page 104 in the workbook) to the reader. The way the series are connected is: A 1 both series diverge because series A diverges by the p-test. D ¢ 2 both series converge because series D converges by geometric series test. B + 3 both series converge because series B converges by the p-test. C + 4 both series converge because series C converges by the p-test.
